item.title: 🔵 BGP ORIGIN attribute manipulation and its impact on the Internet
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
By doing in-depth testing, we found nearly 70% of BGP paths experience ORIGIN attribute rewrites by transit providers seeking traffic advantages. We examine the global impact of this practice and argue for deprecating ORIGIN in route selection.

Source: Cloudflare Blog  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 2d ago

item.title: 🔵 HN835: The Pros and Cons of Shortest Path Bridging (SPB)
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
Shortest Path Bridging (SPB) remains an intriguing and reliable fabric technology, offering a unique approach to Ethernet that differs from more widely deployed fabrics such as EVPN/VXLAN. Jeff Wilson joins Ethan and Drew to share his experience designing and managing SPB-based fabrics. Together they discuss how SPB simplifies multicast, essential hardware design considerations for scaling,... Read more »

Source: Packet Pushers  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 2d ago
